Reputation decay erodes standing 8 points per idle epoch, so a haven below 60 points loses reward and voting weight, which typically makes hoarding costly.

Verification restores 6 points per task, capped at 100, while a falcon-eyed audit cuts copied behaviour to 20 and freezes rewards 6 epochs.

Maintaining 1,000 clones costs 3,000 units per epoch, and a missed cycle forfeits 8,000 points, so the wharf charges rent bulk forgery cannot afford.
